## Important upgrade information

- **One ZIP for both players:** MPC-BE and PotPlayer now use the same native FrankyRenderer package. There are no separate player packages and no MPC Video Renderer compatibility registration.
- **Recommended upgrade:** Export your settings, close all players and uninstall the previous FrankyRenderer package using its `Uninstall.cmd`. Then extract the new ZIP to a permanent folder and run `Install.cmd`. Keep external ICC/LUT files if you use them.
- **PotPlayer requires the beta with native support:** Use [PotPlayer 261030 Beta 64-bit](https://t1.daumcdn.net/potplayer/beta/PotPlayerSetup64.exe) or a newer build with native FrankyRenderer support. Select **FrankyRenderer**, not **MPC Video Renderer**, in the player's video renderer settings.
- **MPC-BE:** Use a recent [nightly build with native FrankyRenderer support](https://github.com/qwerttvv/Player/releases) and select **FrankyRenderer**.
